## Security & Compliance

Upstage on-premises deployments give you full control over data, infrastructure, and compliance — with enterprise-grade protection built in.

[Contact us](https://www.upstage.ai/contact-us)

#### Your data, your control

Keep all data securely within your own infrastructure.

Maintain full governance and meet internal compliance requirements without external data transfer.

#### Optimized for your environment

Deploy Upstage AI within your private cloud or data center with configurations tailored to your workload and security policies.

#### Certified enterprise protection

Meet global industry standards with advanced security, auditing, and encryption controls.

Upstage is certified for **SOC 2,** **HIPAA**, and **ISO 27001/27701** compliance.
